---
name: Feature Request / 功能建议
about: Suggest a new feature or capability. / 提出新功能或新能力。
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Summary / 概要

请简要描述你希望新增的功能。

Please briefly describe the new feature you'd like.

## Motivation / 使用场景

What problem would this solve? How would you use it?

这个功能解决了什么问题？你会在什么场景下使用？

## Proposed Solution / 建议方案

Any ideas on how to implement? (optional)

你对实现有什么想法？（选填）

## Screenshots or References / 截图或参考

If applicable, attach mockups, screenshots, or reference links.

如果方便，请附上示意图、截图或参考链接。
